source: Codex re-probe c8 (no login: 9 retried 401s over about 15 s, then httpConnectionFailed 401), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; model/list reply spliced from re-probe cat (3 of 8 rows, descriptions neutralized) (model/list was never recorded without a login); thread/start sandbox echo and turn/start sandboxPolicy adapted from the recorded read-only bound to dangerFullAccess (full, the only bound VIA admits); reduced to two retries, the transport-fallback warning and the final error; URLs, cf-ray and request ids removed; the run ends at VIA's stdin close (await_eof) after its last close, as the probe closed stdin at the end of the run (exit 0 recorded)

expect.notes: Without a login thread/start and turn/start are accepted; error notifications with willRetry:true are progress diagnostics, not terminals; turn/completed failed with codexErrorInfo httpConnectionFailed{401} gives class hint auth (C2 §6.2 Class hints; vendors/codex.md §5). The `warning` is activity only.
